title: ‘Shocking’ decline seen in hep B vaccination against incurable virus, including babies with infected mothers
summary: Fewer newborns are being vaccinated against hepatitis B, an incurable infection that can lead to liver disease, a large new analysis has found.

title: Family of teen killed by Georgia police officer demands release of body camera footage
summary: The family of a Black teenager in Georgia who was killed in a police shooting said Tuesday that it wants transparency and called on the police department to release the officer body camera footage.

title: Kilmar Abrego Garcia lands in Spain a ‘free man’ after deportation battle
summary: Kilmar Abrego Garcia is in Spain after voluntarily leaving the United States on Tuesday, ending a closely watched and controversial deportation battle that became a symbol of the Trump administration’s immigration crackdown.

title: Military families fight for fixes to healthcare program
summary: NBC News’ Erin McLaughlin reports for the series “The Cost of Denial” about the military families who say they are receiving bills they shouldn’t - in some cases - even as they are battling terminal illness.
